name: ai-utilities
description: Utility skills for building and vetting Claude Code extensions (skill-creator, skill-review) and for closing the plan-to-implementation loop: plan-completion-audit derives its checks from the plan and the detected stack, and audit-resolver executes the findings behind per-batch gates.

interface.shortDescription: Author, review, and audit Claude Code extensions and plans
interface.longDescription: A utility toolkit of four skills and one command. skill-creator scaffolds, rebuilds, validates and packages Claude Code skills or plugins. skill-review runs a security, safety and quality review of a marketplace, plugin or skill before install. plan-completion-audit audits a plan against what was built, deriving its checks from the plan and the detected stack rather than running a fixed list, and reports every check family with an explicit outcome and a reason. audit-resolver reads those findings and applies the fixes behind per-finding safety gates. The audit-resolve command chains the two.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a new Claude Code skill for this purpose.
Review this plugin or marketplace for security and quality before I install it.
Audit this plan against the implementation, then resolve the findings.
